title: Rate Card Note — Steps on the Reinstatement Fee of a Building Automation Service Plan after a Long Outage
content:
# Rate Card Note — Steps on the Reinstatement Fee of a Building Automation Service Plan after a Long Outage

**The step.** Where the site has stood without monitoring for more than sixty days and the plan's covered points stand above the tier's covered maximum, the tier's reinstatement fee under the Building Automation Service Plans is raised by forty per cent. Where the site has stood without monitoring for more than sixty days and the plan's covered points stand at or below the tier's covered maximum, the tier's reinstatement fee is raised by twenty per cent. In every other case the charge starts from the tier's reinstatement fee unraised. The raised fee is taken to two decimal places.

| Days the site has stood without monitoring | Plan's covered points against the tier's covered maximum | Fee this line carries |
|---|---|---|
| more than 60 | above it | the tier's reinstatement fee raised by 40 per cent |
| more than 60 | at or below it | the tier's reinstatement fee raised by 20 per cent |
| 60 or fewer | either | the tier's reinstatement fee |

## Boundary reading

A site that has stood without monitoring for exactly 60 days carries neither step, both steps needing more than sixty days. Covered points standing exactly at the tier's covered maximum fall in the second row, that row being at or below the maximum.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A plan whose tier carries a reinstatement fee of 500 USD, at a site 75 days without monitoring and covering more points than the tier's covered maximum, carries 500 USD raised by 40 per cent, that is 700.00 USD. At the same tier with covered points at or below the maximum, it carries 500 USD raised by 20 per cent, that is 600.00 USD. At 60 days or fewer it carries 500.00 USD.
